scope: Local working tree; Playwright browser; synthetic Auth0, family API and WebRTC fixtures. No production logs or private conversations read.

findings.title: Stalled topic update blocks later voice replies
findings.cause: The HTTP build phase has only the physical-call abort signal. The session.update acknowledgement timeout starts after the HTTP build returns. The tool and language configuration queues remain occupied while HTTP is pending.

findings.title: Changing the on-screen student never informs the active voice call
findings.cause: configure updates entry only, while LocalProfileVoice continues receiving the original session.props.profile. Its selectedProfileId effect cannot observe the on-screen selection.

findings.title: Deleting the student being discussed leaves the voice call active
findings.cause: The deletion guard checks the editor's local voiceActive, which is false when SharedVoice owns the call. FamilyStore.removeStudent does not publish a privacy forget event or terminate/invalidate the matching shared conversation.

findings.title: Stalled admin access probe traps every signed-in account on account-opening screen
findings.injectedFailure: HTTP admin access response left pending

evidence.status: Opening your account… / Abriendo tu cuenta…

findings.cause: All personal app entry waits for the admin access result; the probe has no deadline and the pending screen has no retry, logout or escape controls.

findings.title: Admin service failure is mistaken for lack of admin access
findings.injectedFailure: Admin access returned HTTP 503; remaining account services healthy
findings.cause: response.ok=false and thrown errors both assign allowed:false, collapsing unverified access into denied access and permitting normal onboarding routing.

ruledOut.candidate: No student profile produces a dead-end home
ruledOut.evidence: The actual app renders Add my profile; this candidate is not a finding.
